prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro witch bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin deep purple stretch velvet with thin shoulder straps and a silver crescent-moon clasp at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just above the diamond, the two sides of the stretch velvet fully covering her bust, a large diamond-shaped cutout down the center of her stomach from under her bust to her lower belly with her navel inside it, the skin inside bare, the stretch velvet remaining at her waist sides and flanks, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole right thigh and the side of her right hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones with small silver stars sewn along it, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the stretch velvet shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin stretch velvet molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the crescent-moon clasp, the small silver stars and the sharp clean edges of the diamond cutout, a soft velvet pile that shifts from deep purple to near black in the folds. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme legendary bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy deep purple leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in deep purple lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
